_comment: Insight nodes for boss name reveals. Per the locked doctrine: name reveal fires from the surface that genuinely teaches the player the name -- NOT necessarily from the death itself. For Lupa specifically, neither the Vagrant nor the Guide knows her name (the Guide remembers her only as 'the beast on the slope'); 'Lupa' is a deep-lore reveal that lands LATER via Grimoire fragments or future Wood-side NPCs who remember the old apex predators. The knows_lupa node has NO declarative trigger today -- it's a manually-set node, fired by the eventual reveal surface (which doesn't ship yet). Until then the lang entries for Lupa stay at tier-0 ('???' / 'FELLED') across the whole playable surface, which is the lore-correct framing for the player's first encounter with her.
